column1: # Game profile of Assassin's Creed: The Rebel Collection (Switch, base v0 = 1.0.0; the collection holds Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag and Assassin's Creed Rogue).
# Ubisoft's AnvilNext engine on NVN, SDK 8 (sdk build 3ae34e689d7a35f13cbf42bfd672af8b). Modules main + sdk.
# The collection is a shell that starts the game as another program of itself: nn::oe::ExecuteProgram(0, "/launcher:off /gamesoundlanguage:en ..."), with the SDK's
# by-name nn::vi::OpenDisplay("Default") first. The host hooks both (docs/reference/services.md), so the shell re-launches the host into the game (the note's bring-up).
# RomFS: 28 Ubisoft "scimitar" .forge archives (11.2 GB) hold the game data and 45,853 shader-library records whose payloads are packed, and no reader decodes them
# (docs/reference/shaders.md), so the shader map is main's 326 programs plus the programs a run dumped as missing from the map: shader_split.py reads a
# DM_NVN_SHDUMP directory back as a source, and /shdump/=main files them in main's package. The note says what was played and what is still open.
# the archive every .forge is layered under (an update adds its own copies of these)
# stored in the app, not compressed: the movies and the forge data are already compressed
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# /shdump/ is a host dump directory (DM_NVN_SHDUMP, shader_split.py's dumped_shaders): its programs belong to main's package, the only package with game-file rows
